co_upper_dream_canyon.name: Upper Dream Canyon
co_upper_dream_canyon.note: No source names months; only wall-aspect advice (south/west walls in cool months, shady in summer).

co_hartman_rocks.name: Hartman Rocks
co_hartman_rocks.note: Only 'milder periods outside summer heat and winter snow'; no months named.

nm_capulin_canyon.name: Capulin Canyon
nm_capulin_canyon.note: AAC: 'best between October and May' (road often closed Jan-Feb by snow); MP area text: fall/spring ideal. Consistent.

ny_near_trapps_the.name: The Near Trapps
ny_near_trapps_the.note: Reviewer: Gunks system window confirmed in round 3 (outfitter Apr to mid-Nov; Sep-Oct prime). MP: Sep-Oct prime, fall can run into December; guide: spring season mid-March to end of May (wetter, buggy). Peregrine closures spring/summer.

co_rmnp_rock.name: Rocky Mountain National Park
co_rmnp_rock.note: Only National Geographic (rock April to October; Lumpy Ridge opens April); raptor closures Feb-July. One source, not confirmed.

nh_boulder_natural.name: Boulder Natural
nh_boulder_natural.note: Sources say autumn best, spring buggy (May-June black flies); season words only, no months.

ny_d_keene_valley_and_chapel_pond.name: Keene Valley and Chapel Pond
ny_d_keene_valley_and_chapel_pond.note: No months for rock; ice is the famous season there; DEC peregrine closure checks May-Aug.

on_mount_nemo.name: Mount Nemo
on_mount_nemo.note: Gripped calls it a good spring crag (afternoon sun, north-facing); no months named.

or_callahans_the.name: The Callahans
or_callahans_the.note: No Callahans-specific season found; only Oregon-wide 'spring and fall'.

wa_tum_tum.name: Tum Tum
wa_tum_tum.note: No months found in text; season chart not readable.

ca_rock_creek.name: Rock Creek
ca_rock_creek.note: Aggregator pages only: late spring through fall, snow closes winter; no named months from a solid source.

nm_southern_box_areas.name: Southern Box areas
nm_southern_box_areas.note: Described as a winter destination (Climbing mag); no months named.

ca_pine_mountain.name: Pine Mountain
ca_pine_mountain.note: Sources conflict (fall-spring vs late spring-early fall); snow closures usually Nov-Feb. No months named as best.

nc_2_northern_mountains_region.name: Northern Mountains Region
nc_2_northern_mountains_region.note: Regional; blogs say spring and fall, some crags fall and winter; no months.

az_2_bear_canyon.name: Bear Canyon
az_2_bear_canyon.note: Only general Mt Lemmon best months (Feb, Apr, May, Sep-Nov per mountain-forecast); raptor closures Jan-Jul; not crag-specific.

ca_echo_cliffs.name: Echo Cliffs
ca_echo_cliffs.note: Spring and fall comfortable, climbable most of year; no months named.

ca_real_hidden_valley.name: Real Hidden Valley
ca_real_hidden_valley.note: Joshua Tree prime season October to April (some say to early May; warm at both ends); Hidden Valley guide says fall-to-spring. Raptor closures may apply.

id_q_emilin_park.name: Q'Emiln Park
id_q_emilin_park.note: Only an aggregator listing all months; no real source.

ny_e_high_peaks_region.name: High Peaks Region
ny_e_high_peaks_region.note: One guide listing says April to mid-October; not confirmed by a second source.

bc_fraser_valley.name: Fraser Valley
bc_fraser_valley.note: Only Chehalis Gorge (April-September) from one aggregator; not a regional season.

ny_the_trapps.name: The Trapps
ny_the_trapps.note: Reviewer: Gunks system window (round 3, Trapps Bouldering sources); held in round 1 for season words only.
